text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perihal Dagangan
(Penandaan Topi Keledar Motosikal) 2012.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 September 2012.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Perintah ini, "topi keledar" ertinya topi keledar mengikut pengertian
Kaedah-Kaedah Motosikal (Topi Keledar) 1973 [ P.U. (A) 43/1973 ] dan yang telah
mematuhi kehendak spesifikasi yang dinyatakan di bawah kaedah 3 Kaedah-Kaedah itu.

Penandaan topi keledar motosikal

3. Topi keledar motosikal yang dibekalkan atau ditawarkan untuk dibekalkan
hendaklah mempunyai tanda yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual mengikut
standard yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2 ) Jadual , mengikut mana -mana yang
berkenaan.

4. Topi keledar motosikal yang digunakan bagi sampel pengujian dikecualikan
daripada pemakaian Perintah ini.

TRADE DESCRIPTIONS ACT 2011

TRADE DESCRIPTIONS (MARKING OF MOTORCYCLE SAFETY HELMET) ORDER 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 29(1) (b) of the Trade Descriptions
Act 2011 [Act 730], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Trade Descriptions (Marking of
Motorcycle Safety Helmet) Order 2012.

  (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 September 2012.

Interpretation
2. In this Order, "safety helmet" means a safety helmet within the meaning of the
Motor-Cycles (Safety Hel mets) Rules 1973 [ P.U. (A) 43/1973 ] and  has complied with
specification requirements specified under rule 3 of the Rules.

Marking of motorcycle safety helmet
3. A motorcycle safety helmet supplied or offered for supply shall be ar the mark
specified in co lumn (1) of the Schedule according to the standard specified in column
(2) of the Schedule, as the case may be.

SCHEDULE

(1)
Mark
(2)
Standard

XXXXX – Approval number.

Malaysian Standard MS 1 –
Protective Helmets and Visors for Vehicle Users
– Specification.

X – Refers to the Country which
recognizes the compliance of
standard.
YYYY– Approval number.

United Nation Economic Commission for Europe
Regulation 22 Uniform Provisions Concerning
the Approval of Protective Helmets and of Their
Visors for Drivers and Passengers of Motor
Cycles and Mopeds.

Exemption
4. Motorcycle safety helmet used for test sampling is exempted from the
application of this Order.

Made 29 February 2012
[KPDN(BUU)(PU2) 26/5/56 ; PN(PU2)120/VI]
